question.prompt: If \(20 \%\) of a number is \(12,\) what is \(30\%\) of the same number?

solutions.explanation:
Because both percentages refer to the same number, equal percentage shares have equal amounts. Half of \(20\%\) is \(10\%\), so \(10\%\) of the number is \(12\div2=6\).

Now \(30\%\) consists of three such shares, giving \(3\cdot6=18\). The answer is \(18\), choice \(B\).
solutions.title: Use ten-percent shares
